verdict.rationale: Zapier lets you create an MCP server, generate a connection token for a specific agent client (zapier-docs-28), and curate that server's tool list (zapier-docs-30). It markets "managed auth and permissions you control" with account-level restrictions and workspace controls (zapier-docs-25, zapier-docs-15), and the SDK supports client-credentials auth (zapier-docs-26). Together this gives a per-agent credential bounded to chosen tools, but the evidence never documents explicit scopes or least-privilege permissions on the tokens themselves. missing for 10: documented per-token scope/permission granularity, token expiry/rotation/revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of least-privilege enforcement.
